title: K-drama filming locations: 9 spots in Gyeonggi & Busan
desc: Well-known K-drama filming locations around Gyeonggi province and Busan, grouped by region.

items.title: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (수원 화성)
items.memo: UNESCO-listed fortress walls; a backdrop for Mr. Sunshine and many period dramas.

items.title: Korean Folk Village (한국민속촌)
items.memo: Open-air folk village in Yongin, a frequent set for historical dramas.

items.title: Heyri Art Village (헤이리 예술마을)
items.memo: Art village in Paju with galleries and cafes; used for indie-style drama scenes.

items.title: Songdo Beach (송도해수욕장)
items.memo: Descendants of the Sun beach walk and sunset scenes were filmed here.

items.title: BIFF Square (BIFF 광장)
items.memo: Festival street near Nampo Station; Descendants of the Sun street scenes.

items.title: Taejongdae (태종대)
items.memo: Coastal cliffs seen in the final episodes of Descendants of the Sun.

items.title: Gamcheon Culture Village (감천문화마을)
items.memo: Colourful hillside alleys seen in Descendants of the Sun and Moonlight Drawn by Clouds.

items.title: Jagalchi Market (자갈치시장)
items.memo: Busan's big fish market, often used for street-food and local-life scenes.

items.title: Nurimaru APEC House (누리마루 APEC하우스)
items.memo: Seaside APEC venue on Dongbaek Island; appears as a wealthy residence in Goblin.
